<function name="SetNoCollideWithTeammates" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets whenever the player should not collide with their teammates, based on their <page>Player:Team</page>.

<note>This will only work for teams with ID 1 to 4 due to internal Engine limitations.</note>
<note>This causes traces with <page text="COLLISION_GROUP_PLAYER">Enums/COLLISION_GROUP</page> to pass through players.</note>
</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="shouldNotCollide" type="boolean">`true` to disable, `false` to enable collision.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
